services.name: Waipahu Warehouse Direct Inventory Sales
services.scope: Brand-new factory-sealed LG Dual Inverter ($560 to $1,025), LG Standard ($395 to $895), and GE Built-In ($1,000 to $1,200) units in stock at 94-150 Leoleo St #203. Same-day local pickup available.

services.name: Hawaii Energy Cash Rebate
services.scope: Instant or mail-in cash rebate for Oahu residential electric customers purchasing qualifying Energy Star window AC models only.

services.name: Island-Wide Flat Rate Delivery
services.scope: Delivery to residential or commercial addresses across eligible Oahu service zones (Central Oahu, Metro Honolulu, Leeward Kapolei/Ewa Beach, and Windward Kailua/Kaneohe) for $50 flat rate.

services.name: Standard & Custom Window AC Installation
services.scope: Custom fabrication for jalousie glass, vertical horizontal slider filler panel, 26" thru-the-wall sleeves, or double-hung window. Weatherproof marine foam sealing, floor drop cloth protection, laser leveling. Standard exterior sill support brackets optional.

services.name: Window AC Deep Cleaning & Coil Sanitization
services.scope: Filter wash, evaporator and condenser coil foaming wash, condensate drain pan flush, and mold & salt-air sanitization with floor drop cloths.

services.name: Clean vs. Replace Evaluation
services.scope: Guidance on maintenance and cleaning for newer quality window units vs upgrading to energy-efficient LG Dual Inverters ($560–$1,025) or GE Built-In ($1,000–$1,200) units for aged units with corroded coils or failing compressors. Zero off-site shop teardowns.
